verdict.rationale: The Inference API docs say generated clients are available for the Connect, gRPC, and Protobuf ecosystems across many languages. That implies a machine-readable Protobuf schema exists, and a CKS API reference page is also documented. However, no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or Protobuf spec file. Missing for 10: an explicit downloadable spec artifact (OpenAPI/proto files or registry link), spec coverage beyond the Inference API (e.g., CKS, storage, billing), and independent or hands-on confirmation.
